data.text: User explicitly requires Python application backend and TypeScript frontend. Use FastAPI + Python sqlite3 + in-process Pydantic AI. Preserve existing client API/status contracts and simulation/idempotency/approval boundaries. Port active TypeScript API features to the Python runtime; keep browser as API consumer.
data.rationale: Latest user instruction overrides earlier Fastify-centered implementation; Pydantic AI is now the application's agent runtime rather than an optional subprocess.
